findings.title: Doc claims reading until throw closes the source, but unmarshall failures don't
findings.claim: The doc (and doc/rpc-streaming.md:110) says reading until it throws closes the source and there is no other way to do it, but source_impl::operator() only calls close_source() on stream_receive failure or eof; if unmarshall() throws inside process_one_buffer, the exception propagates while _source_closed stays false, so an application following the documented contract leaks the stream connection.

findings.title: test_stream_send_after_stream_close doesn't cover the queue-drain half of the fix
findings.claim: The test only fires the hook after stream_close() has set _stream_closing, covering only the send() refusal path; it never has an entry accepted before the flag and still queued when the buffer closes, so the std::exchange(_outgoing_queue_ready, ...)/then_wrapped change in src/rpc/rpc.cc:562-570 could be reverted and the test would still pass.
